analysis: The trial executed successfully but reduced host validation macro HR@10 to 0.4363, below the immediate reference of 0.4838 and historical best of 0.5375. Category HR@10 was 0.435 Movies_and_TV, 0.480 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.375 Electronics, and 0.455 CDs_and_Vinyl. All four declined versus the supplied immediate category references. Separating context and candidate embeddings did not help under this configuration; the results favor shared embeddings, although they do not establish why untied embeddings performed worse. Allocated GPU time was 1,702.83 seconds.
code_summary: Per-category SASRec uses two causal Transformer blocks, 64-dimensional embeddings, two attention heads, and gated preference pooling with a ten-interaction half-life. This trial added an independently trainable output embedding table initialized from the context table, used for positive scoring, hard-negative mining, negative rescoring, and prediction. Training retained 144 sampled negatives, position-specific top-16 mining plus 16 uniform negatives, 33-way cross-entropy, recency-weighted supervision, and AdamW. Metadata and the generated predictor reconstruct and strictly load the untied architecture for all four dataset routes.
